audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text, whys[4], whys[6], mid and late all describe Golden Eclipse as a 'burst-reflect' ultimate or 'reflect zone'. Golden Eclipse does not reflect anything.
audit.why: Riot text: Golden Eclipse 'strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her, dealing additional damage for each stack of Overwhelm.' Range 25000, cooldown 120/100/80. The reflect belongs to Rebuttal (W), 38/35/33/29/26s, which 'reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker'. Two separate abilities were merged into one fabricated mechanic across five fields.
audit.corrected: Golden Eclipse is a global detonation of accumulated Overwhelm stacks; Rebuttal is the projectile reflect. Galio's spike map: Justice Punch at 3, Hero's Entrance at 6 (180/160/140s, 4000/4750/5500 range), first item, and the Rebuttal cooldown gap once it falls to 26s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction — Galio's Q (Winds of War) being a projectile that Rebuttal reflects — is stated only vaguely, and Solar Snare's 1000-range root versus Galio's 650-range E is never mentioned at all.
audit.why: ownerKit Q carries the projectile flag; enemyKit W reflects projectiles and prevents her taking damage. enemyKit E is a 1000-range root on an 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 cooldown, which out-ranges Justice Punch (650) and stops the dash Galio needs to reach her. missingInteractions also flags shield-absorbs-burst and the Searing Brilliance auto-reset tell.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal reflects Winds of War and blocks the damage — poke only after it drops (38s at rank 1, 26s at rank 5). Solar Snare roots at 1000 range, outside Justice Punch's 650, so it is the ability that denies the engage. Searing Brilliance loads her next auto with bonus projectiles after any cast, so the wind-up is the burst tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the one field that exists to hold real numbers. Rebuttal, Solar Snare and Shield of Durand all have per-rank cooldowns in the kits.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal 38s at rank 1 to 26s at rank 5; Solar Snare 11s to 9s; Shield of Durand 18s at rank 1.
